why: design/exported-units.md: a method or function-valued property of an exported object literal is a unit <binding>.<key>; its receiver is the literal (the class-method reading), so this.base is a field of the receiver operand and this.add reaches the sibling unit ops.add. Only add changed: add, its sibling caller viaSibling and the module caller useOps differ; scale, shift and label are untouched and listed.
why_b: Lane B cannot call a literal unit yet: exec/run.mjs pickUnit resolves a free function or a class only, so ops.* answer ASK (parent: unit not exported). The fix is one pickUnit branch (resolve exports[binding][key], call it with the literal as this); exec/ was outside this lane's contract. useOps, a plain function calling ops.add, is a WITNESS.
